scope: HBQ whole-vehicle writer lifecycle and exclusive handover preconditions

sources.review_scope: selected admission and mutation guard inspection

findings.evidence: start launches driveAssist, unstuckLoop, crewHold and unflipLoop independently; initVehicle installs Local restart after its delayed enabled check.
findings.consequence: Stopping one main driving writer is not a whole-vehicle handover.

findings.evidence: driveAssist inactive branch observes Pause and releases its local traffic/overtaking holds. unflipLoop does not observe Pause; crewHold and already queued crew callbacks do not use it.
findings.consequence: Pause is not exclusive authority over vehicle pose, seat or crew-policy writers.

findings.evidence: unstuckLoop processes RouteLost before constructing the normal Blocked expression containing Pause. feature calls enabled first, so Disable is still respected at that feature check; Pause is the bypassed guard.
findings.consequence: Do not claim that Pause suppresses the lost-route teleport path; do not incorrectly claim Disable is ignored at the feature check.

findings.evidence: push registers a machine EachFrame writer using PushList, local/alive/deadline/velocity/contact checks; neither Pause nor Disable is tested. Expired entries also have a final velocity cleanup write.
findings.consequence: Wait for actual push entry retirement and its final cleanup; flags or elapsed nominal duration alone cannot acknowledge quiescence.

findings.evidence: crewHold GetOut validates feature/assignment initially. Its delayed0.5s seat mutation checks alive/mobility/on-foot but not feature/assignment/locality/controller/episode again.
findings.consequence: Running=false is not proof that a queued seat mutation cannot execute later. No pending actor/episode acknowledgement is exposed by this helper.

findings.evidence: Disable suppresses enabled/feature and causes main loops to retire at their checks; clearing it alone does not execute start. Init Local restart and explicit start are separate paths. Per-vehicle Enable overrides the global enable setting.
findings.consequence: A future adapter must preserve the original per-vehicle/global baseline and explicitly establish restart ownership; toggling a global CBA setting is not scoped handover.

findings.evidence: crewHold changes unload/allowCrewInImmobile and its exit only clears its running marker; main traffic release resets forceSpeed; original caller-owned policy baselines are not a common receipt.
findings.consequence: A handover must track per-property restoration independently and cannot restore a generic default over a new controller.

required_future_contract: Owner-local REQUESTED -> QUIESCING -> QUIESCENT_ACK -> CBE_OWNED -> RELEASING -> PROVIDER_RESUMED, scoped to vehicle, issuer, token, generation and owner epoch.
Quiescence acknowledgement covers all four worker families, active push entries and final velocity writes, queued seat callbacks, gate cleanup and delayed damage restoration; not just Running flags.
Do not issue CBE movement until real acknowledgement. Missing acknowledgement leaves handover unimplemented/unavailable, never a synthetic success.
Capture exact previous per-vehicle enable/pause/disable and modified property baselines, preserve nil versus explicit values, and restore only exact still-owned writes.
Revalidate driver/operator/crew/route/player/Zeus/external ownership immediately before every command and before resume. Old owner cannot restart a successor provider instance.
Resume through actual current-owner provider entry points, with acknowledgement and physically observed authored-order execution. No edits to installed originals or preserved baselines.
core_implementation_lessons: Every delayed CBE mutation must carry exact episode/owner/context and recheck admission after waits; no special lost-route branch bypasses current pause/ownership.
CBE finite physical recovery must use native movement; upstream teleport, velocity pushes, forced repair/refuel and forced boarding are not implementation parity.
Apply these lessons to individual/FSM execution first. Compatibility expansion remains last, as the user requires.

remaining: No public all-writer quiescence/queued-callback acknowledgement proved. An actual adapter and loaded-source physical tests remain required; ordinary markers/detection do not count.
